cases.objective: Verify that a user can log in successfully with a valid registered email and password
cases.precondition: User has a registered account and is on the Habitnu login screen

steps.expected_result: Email field is focused and keyboard appears
Email is entered and no error message is shown
steps.step: Enter a valid registered email address

steps.expected_result: Password field is focused
Password is entered as masked characters
User is navigated to the home/dashboard screen

cases.title: Successful sign in with valid credentials

cases.objective: Verify that submitting with an empty email field triggers the 'Please enter a valid email id' error
cases.precondition: User is on the Habitnu login screen

steps.expected_result: Email field remains empty
Email field is highlighted in red with the message 'Please enter a valid email id'

cases.title: Error shown when email field is empty on sign in

cases.objective: Verify that entering an email without proper format triggers the email validation error
cases.precondition: User is on the Habitnu login screen

steps.expected_result: Text is entered in the field
steps.step: Tap the Email field and enter an invalid email

steps.expected_result: Email field is highlighted in red with 'Please enter a valid email id' error message

cases.title: Invalid email format shows validation error

cases.objective: Verify that an email missing the domain part (e.g. user@) is rejected with a validation error
cases.precondition: User is on the Habitnu login screen

steps.expected_result: Text is entered in the field
steps.step: Tap the Email field and enter a partial email

steps.expected_result: Email field shows 'Please enter a valid email id' error

cases.title: Invalid email with missing domain shows error

cases.objective: Verify that entering a correct email but incorrect password shows an authentication error

steps.expected_result: Email is accepted with no error
